about: Two rows any self-payment rule in x402#2887 must classify correctly before it counts a funding edge or a settlement. Both are real Base transactions on payee 0x161dbdd73d025e9aedd4918a67c28e5bf9a87fb9.

vectors.why: A token contract with one holder emits Transfer(from=payee). The payee never signed it. Its address imitates 0x4faba7514c3796b72b3dc91dda7ed1c85e73a841, which the payee really paid 30 USDC minutes earlier.

expect.rule: a funding edge counts only if token == 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913 (canonical USDC on Base)

vectors.why: Real USDC, 0.00003, pushed by a poisoning contract with a plain transfer. No facilitator submitted it and nobody bought anything.

expect.rule: a plain transfer (0xa9059cbb) is not a facilitator settlement; same exclusion as ../submitter_join.py
